text: Android: missing 'Clear checked' bulk action (web has it; user-requested feature)

LWW correctness trap: the bulk checked->backlog op must stamp each row's status
field clock (status_updatedAt/status_updatedBy) and set dirty=true per row. A
plain `UPDATE items SET status_value='backlog' WHERE ...` changes the value but
NOT the clock/dirty, so the change never syncs (and would lose to any concurrent
edit on merge). Mirror ItemsRepo.setStatus's stamping, just batched. Snackbar
undo just re-runs the batched setStatus back to 'checked'.

Done in 2e97a4f. Web-parity "Clear checked (N)" bulk action for Android.

Semantics mirror web: visible only when checked items exist, count shown, one
repo call -> one dirty batch -> one sync push. ItemsRepo.clearChecked(listId)
reads the checked set once (new ItemDao.itemsForListByStatusOnce), re-stamps each
row backlog via the same LWW path as setStatus (status clock advances + dirty),
then a single syncTrigger.scheduleAfterEdit(). Followed note#1's trap exactly - no
bare status_value UPDATE. Undo = ItemsRepo.setStatusBulk(ids, CHECKED); the ids are
held in a ListUiState.clearedCheckedIds channel separate from the single-item
check-off undo, and clearChecked() clears the single-item undo so only one snackbar
shows at a time.

Placement: chose a dedicated row directly under the controls row (shown only when
checkedCount>0), destructive-colored TextButton, rather than inline next to the
Show-checked switch - that right cluster already holds switch + registry + settings
and a fifth wide element would crowd/overflow on a phone. Reads as "alongside" the
toggle per the note, never overflows.

Tests: ItemsRepoTest (batch move stamps clock+dirty, ignores todo/other-list/
deleted, one-sync-push, empty-noop, setStatusBulk restore+skip-unknown),
ListViewModelTest (checkedCount vs toggle, clear arms undo + count->0, undo
restores), ListScreenTest (button shows "Clear checked (2)" and click bulk-moves to
backlog - uses the Unconfined query-context pattern from T-29 for determinism).
Verified: :app:testDebugUnitTest + :app:lintDebug green.

Not done: the "maybe snackbar undo (restore previous statuses)" nuance - since only
CHECKED rows are ever cleared, restoring to CHECKED is exact, so no per-row prior-
status capture is needed.
